(rule!
 ;; Collapse each object to a single cell of its color at its bbox CENTER.
 (for/fold ((out (empty-grid h w 0))) ((obj (in-list (objects g 0))))
   (set-cell out
             (quotient (+ (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj)) 2)
             (quotient (+ (obj-c1 obj) (obj-c2 obj)) 2)
             (obj-color obj))))
